title: Andy’s Play
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy stars in a production of Sweeney Todd and invites his coworkers to the closing night. Michael struggles with not being cast and initially refuses to attend but later shows up with supportive gestures. Jim and Pam face babysitting challenges which Erin helps resolve by agreeing to babysit Cece. The play features humorous moments including a disruptive cell phone and playful banter among coworkers. Dwight and Angela humorously negotiate attendance and their contractual obligations. After the play, the group gives Andy mixed but mostly supportive feedback, and Michael defends Andy against criticism. The episode ends with Andy feeling lonely but encouraged as the group joins him in song.
